mainEntity.name: Can I use generated images for commercial purposes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! You retain 100% full intellectual property ownership, copyright, and commercial licensing for all images processed through PngLike. You are free to use them on Amazon, Shopify, marketing collateral, client deliverables, YouTube thumbnails, and print merchandise without royalties.

mainEntity.name: Is my image data kept private?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PngLike processes files in-memory using localized ONNX neural networks. We do not sell your photos, train generative models on your private portraits, or inspect your creations. Guest outputs are stored only ephemerally and automatically cleaned up.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Guest and Registered user accounts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Guests can process up to 3 images daily with a 10 MB file size cap. Creating a free registered account (verified via Gmail) immediately unlocks 100 generations per day (in 10-image bursts with 30-minute rest cooldowns), 50 MB upload limits, personal cloud gallery history, and full access to all 9 neural tools.

mainEntity.name: Which neural network model should I select?

acceptedAnswer.text: For general photos, products, and objects, U2-Net or IS-Net General delivers the highest edge quality. For human portraits with complex hair strands, choose U2-Net Human Seg. For rapid bulk processing, choose U2-Netp or Silueta. For manga and illustration artwork, select IS-Net Anime.

Alpha Matting is a refined mathematical post-processing pass that examines the trimap boundary between subject and background. It calculates continuous transparency values (alpha from 0.0 to 1.0) along fuzzy borders, ensuring that fine hair strands, fur, transparent glass, and veil fabric blend naturally without jagged halos.
